nodes.label: Ottoman Military Preparation Montage
nodes.rationale: AI-generated photorealistic 2x2 grid image showing Ottoman soldiers in red robes and distinctive white börk hats with red bands (Janissary-style dress): one drawing a bow before fellow archers at a castle gate, one wielding a curved sword near cannon barrels, blacksmiths forging weapons/cannon parts at a glowing forge, and a soldier carrying a breastplate near wooden siege equipment and army tents. Cinematic, dramatic lighting, stone fortress backdrop consistent with a siege-preparation scene for the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople.
